details:
SPACEVERSE⁷ EXPLORACE, developed by Universe 7, is an interactive, space-themed digital game designed to make learning about space more engaging through gameplay. The project combines the concept of space exploration with digital gaming, giving users an opportunity to experience space-related content in a more interactive and enjoyable way. Users can access the game through a web-based platform without needing to install a separate application.

The main benefit of this project is that it provides an alternative way to introduce space science, particularly to students and younger audiences. Instead of relying only on traditional reading materials or explanations, the game uses an interactive digital experience to encourage curiosity, exploration, and active participation. Its intended impact is to increase interest in space science and make space-related knowledge more approachable and enjoyable.

The project was developed using Google AI Studio as part of the development process and is made accessible through a web-based platform. This approach demonstrates how AI-assisted development and digital technology can be used to create an interactive gaming experience.

The creativity of SPACEVERSE⁷ EXPLORACE comes from presenting the theme of exploring the universe in a game format. It combines education and entertainment, turning a scientific topic into an experience that users can engage with rather than simply read about.

During development, the team considered the game's theme, user experience, accessibility, visual presentation, and the importance of making the experience engaging and easy to understand. Overall, SPACEVERSE⁷ EXPLORACE aims to demonstrate how creative digital games can encourage curiosity and support informal learning about space.
